question: What quivering vision appears at the twelve-end point in this practice?
premises: A quivering jewel garland is seen.
inference: At the twelve-end, one perceives a quivering garland of jewels.
uncertainties: The exact referent of dvādaśānta is technical and context-dependent.
plain_english: When one sees, at the end of the twelve, a quivering garland of jewels.
